# Mouthtype

> Free, open-source local dictation for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.

Hold the shortcut, speak, and release to insert text. Speech recognition runs on the Mac. Models download on first use; dictation can then work offline. No account or cloud transcription service is required. Source is licensed under GPL-3.0. The Linux client is experimental source, not a supported packaged release.

## Product and installation

- [Mouthtype](https://mouthtype.app/): product overview and local dictation workflow.
- [Download](https://mouthtype.app/download/): current stable Mac app and matching source.
- [Get started](https://mouthtype.app/start/): installation, permissions, and first dictation.
- [Why Mouthtype](https://mouthtype.app/why-mouthtype/): product choices and tradeoffs.
